description: A minimal key overlay for minecraft that makes your keybind inputs look satisfying.

mods.name: Pixel Keybind Overlay
mods.description: Minimalist 7-9 box pixel keybind overlay with fixed pixel scale and release fade animations.

releases.notes:
✨ Features
🟩 Joined Zero-Gap Bar: Clean, continuous pitch-black container flush against the corner of your screen with zero borders or gaps.
📦 Dynamic Box Count: Choose anywhere between 1 to 9 key boxes on the fly.
🎨 Smooth Release Fade: Customizable key release fade animation (0.0s to 4.0s) for a smooth visual feel.
🖱️ 100% Reliable Mouse Input: Fully tracks Left Click (LMB), Right Click (RMB), and Middle Click (MMB) in-game.
📐 Pixel-by-Pixel Editor: Interactive edit menu with Arrow Keys, Mouse Dragging, and D-Pad controls for exact 1-pixel positioning.
🖥️ Fixed Pixel Scale: Cancels Minecraft's GUI scale scaling so the overlay stays crisp at your chosen size.
⚙️ How to Open Settings
Press O in-game or click Configure in Mod Menu to open the settings GUI and interactive HUD repositioning menu.
